annotations.text:
Tap through it. Offer → I have it → I sent it → Send code → Done.

THE DELIVERY CODE IS ENFORCED, like the real system. Pretend the customer read you 429117 — type that and it completes. Type anything else, or nothing, and it refuses and burns one of five tries.

The supplier never sees the code in the real page either: it goes to the customer's phone, and only a bcrypt hash is stored.

Tap the pills to switch state.

One status band replaces four stacked coloured sentences — colour, then icon, then a short line. The supplier link is promoted above the merchant's own manual actions, because sending it is the point.
